skill.summary: Use when you need to call deployed Bobine modules with typed params or perform a signed Ed25519 call through an auth module.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of bobine-contract-caller.

- Enables typed Bobine contract calls via `/api/execute`
- Supports unsigned and authenticated Ed25519-signed calls to Bobine modules
- Provides scripts for contract interaction (`call_bobine.mjs`) and Ed25519 key generation (`keygen.mjs`)
- Handles complex param structures and signed call nonce/signature flow
- Outputs results as normalized tagged JSON; logs diagnostics to stderr
- Includes robust safety practices for handling sensitive key material
